question: In which year was the Men's cricket world cup started?
solution:
The correct answer is **1975**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first Men's Cricket World Cup** was held in 1975.
 
• **England** hosted the inaugural tournament.
 
• The event was organized by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)**.
 
• It featured **8 teams** competing in a series of matches.
